items.prompt: A live order has 10 shares. An Execute request for 11 is rejected as OVERFLOW. What business state changes?

options.why: The task does not partially fill an oversized reduction.
The rejected mutation must not create negative resting quantity.
Executed total cannot increase for a rejected execute.

options.text: Neither live quantity nor SHARES changes.
options.why: The business rejection is atomic, while sequence consumption follows its separate rule.
